about: Slides for the recorded walkthrough, opened with Present (Shift+P) in the docs site. English only. Sections and numbers match the case in the sidebar (0 · Overview to 6 · What I'll test next). Each slide has a section, a theme (indigo, lavender, butter, peach, pistachio, paper, night) and a layout (cover, section, points, statement, stats, rows, close) and labels: the H2s of the case page the slide covers, in the page's order. Neighbouring H2s share a slide. Media paths are repo-relative. Every number here is checked against docs/case/*.md.

slides.title: The item stays in words

items.name: Marketplace patterns
items.text: Catalogue search, or a directory of shops to browse
items.detail: The item is structured data with stock levels, kept up to date by each shop

items.name: A concierge that asks the shops
items.text: The shopper asks in their own words; the shopkeeper answers in theirs
items.detail: No catalogue or stock control. It costs minutes of waiting and depends on shops replying

labels: How the transaction shapes each answer
slides.title: Snuffle asks the shops, and every answer can be bought
lines: Through the till where a shop is connected, on WhatsApp where it isn’t
